title: SOMA Auth: Facebook app
_note: Meta's create-app wizard: App details, Use cases, Business, Requirements, Overview. Contact email is prefilled by Meta (mw@mike-wolf.com). Later pages were not inspected before the first run; their targets fall back to a centered tooltip.

steps.instruction: Yeshie typed SOMA as the app name. The contact email is mw@mike-wolf.com. Click Next.
Choose Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login, then click Next.
Choose I do not want to connect a business portfolio yet (unless you want one), then click Next.
Click Next on Requirements, then Create app on Overview. Meta may ask for your password.
